commit.message:
🚀 Phase 6: Production Deployment & Scaling - COMPLETED

✅ MAJOR FEATURES IMPLEMENTED:

🏗️ **Multi-Cloud Infrastructure**:
- AWS EKS deployment with Terraform IaC
- Auto-scaling with HPA and VPA
- Multi-region support with disaster recovery
- Load balancing with intelligent request distribution

🛡️ **Enterprise Security**:
- Zero Trust architecture with RBAC
- Network policies and security contexts
- Secret management with multi-provider support
- Comprehensive audit logging and monitoring

📊 **Production Monitoring**:
- Prometheus metrics collection
- Grafana dashboards with custom alerts
- GPU utilization tracking
- Business intelligence metrics

🔧 **DevOps Automation**:
- Kubernetes-native deployment manifests
- Multi-stage Docker builds with security scanning
- Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
- Automated deployment scripts

🎯 **Deployment Components**:
- Kubernetes manifests (namespace, RBAC, storage, services)
- Auto-scaling configuration (HPA/VPA)
- Ingress with SSL/TLS termination
- Multi-cloud AWS deployment templates
- Production monitoring stack (Prometheus + Grafana)
- Comprehensive deployment automation scripts

Author: Muzan Sano <sanosensei36@gmail.com>
Progress: 90% Complete - Ready for Phase 7 (Continuous Intelligence)
